# `token_ceiling`

Rejects provider-bound requests whose estimated prompt or requested output exceeds configured limits. Missing output-limit fields are rejected when `max_output_tokens` is configured; this strict behavior prevents providers from applying an unbounded model default.

## Configuration

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `max_input_tokens` | integer | no |  |
| `max_output_tokens` | integer | no |  |
| `tokenizer` | `cl100k_base` \| `o200k_base` | no |  |
| `max_body_bytes` | integer | no |  |
